items.source: If a defaultUnit is specified, it may be used in parsing cases when no unit is present in the string (provided the style allows for such a case). It will also be used as the representation's resolution when printing in the DurationFormat.Style.SIMPLE style. Otherwise, the style defines its default unit.
items.translation: 如果指定了 `defaultUnit`，在字符串中未包含单位且样式允许此类情况时，它可用于解析；此外，在打印为 DurationFormat.Style.SIMPLE 样式时，它也将用作表示的分辨率。否则，由样式定义其默认单位。

items.source: When a unit is needed but cannot be determined (for example, printing a Duration in the SIMPLE style), DurationFormat.Unit#MILLIS is used.
items.translation: 当需要单位但无法确定时（例如以`SIMPLE`样式打印`Duration`），将使用`DurationFormat.Unit#MILLIS`。
